factual_claims.source_evidence: '2025 in brief' section: Order backlog 2025: 352 M, 2024: 641 M

factual_claims.claim: Operationally, Sedna-1 and Sedna-2 became fully operational, supporting recurring maritime data revenues, while assembly began on the VIREON Earth Observation constellation and the INFLECION Phase 1 contract was signed.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: 2025 in brief: 'Sedna-1 and Sedna-2 became fully operational... Assembly of the first VIREON™ Earth Observation satellites began... INFLECION Phase 1 contract signed.'

factual_claims.claim: After year-end, AAC received its largest order to date: a EUR 76.3 million, approximately SEK 820 million, contract for 20 EPS-Sterna microwave radiometers.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 36: 'AAC Clyde Space has received an order from OHB Sweden valued at EUR 76.3 M (approx. SEK 820 M) for the delivery of 20 microwave radiometers for the EPS-Sterna satellite programme.'

factual_claims.claim: This increased the order backlog to approximately SEK 1.1 billion by the end of March 2026 and improved the Group’s forward financial visibility.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO Review: 'In March, this resulted in the largest single order in the company’s history... increasing our order backlog to approximately SEK 1.1 billion as of end of March [2026].'
